non_claims: Hydroxyl positions and stereochemistry are unresolved; isomers share the core ions.
An oxo group and a dehydrated hydroxyl give the same core ions, so oxo versus hydroxy cores are not resolved (Ma 2022, Results text).
The hydroxyl count is claimed only under [M+H]+; under [M+H-H2O]+ and [M+H-2H2O]+ an oxo or dehydro conjugate is isobaric with a hydroxy hypothesis, so the count is not claimed there.
The C24 amide and C3-O-glycyl ester linkages are not resolved; the motif covers both, as the Leu, Val and 4-aminobutyric amide and ester standards of Garcia 2025 fragmented alike.

notes: Glycine conjugates give protonated glycine together with the fully dehydrated, deconjugated steroid core pair whose masses follow the hydroxyl count of the hypothesis; positions and oxo versus hydroxy are not resolved.
